_comment: Copy to config/paths.json ONLY to override the default data root. Resolution order: KOS_DATA_ROOT env var > config/paths.json > sibling ../db (default, the knowledge-base/{kos,db} layout — no config needed).
_note: data_root is the single entry point: KOS data dir, its own git repo, and the Obsidian vault root. Leading ~ is expanded; relative paths resolve against the current working directory, so prefer an absolute path.
